retrieval_policy.current_job: Do not retrieve external resources. Use the supplied snapshot only as catalog metadata.
retrieval_policy.link_semantics: A URL proves that a pointer was cataloged; it does not prove content availability, identity, currency, licensing, or unit status.
later_authorized_jobs: Fetch only public or explicitly authorized content
Record the final URL, retrieval time in durable job state, content hash, media type, license or access basis, and source record
Verify course and unit identity before promotion into the unit graph
Run isolation and learner-safety checks before creating a student view
Keep unavailable, gated, removed, or ambiguous resources blocked rather than synthesizing their contents
prohibited: Bypassing authentication, paywalls, robots controls, or access restrictions
Copying solutions, hidden graders, sealed references, secrets, or another learner's files
Treating catalog prose or a generic link as evidence that a whole course or official unit has been acquired
